data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order: EDGAR ticker search, 10-K filter, Wikipedia infobox lookup, then the email with the correct subject template, and it captures all three parameters. However, it leaves out the 10-K period and the {manager}@example.com address format, gives only a loose body template, and says "Discard/send", which is ambiguous where the true workflow explicitly says not to send, so an automation could not be built safely from it alone.
